question: What supreme Eye of the Śiva pair is honored as illumination and all-power?
premises: The Eye is of illumination nature
The Eye belongs to the Śiva pair and is supreme
inference: We bow to that supreme Eye of Śiva and Śakti, whose nature is illumination and all power.
plain_english: We bow to that supreme Eye of the Śiva pair, whose nature is illumination and which possesses all power.
